title: First Time with Clay
transcript:
Hi there. My sister and I fancy trying pottery. Is the beginner session suitable if we've never touched clay before?
Absolutely. You'll each make a small bowl by hand. The class with the wheel is a separate booking.
Hand building sounds more our speed. Is that at your main studio behind the library?
Normally it is, but the beginner group meets in the garden room while we're having the studio floor replaced.
Okay. Have you got a pair of spaces on Thursday evening?
Yes, we can fit you both in at seven fifteen. I'll need both names when you book.
No problem. It says materials are included. Should we bring anything ourselves?
Just an old shirt to wear over your clothes. We'll supply the clay and tools.
And can we take the pieces home that evening?
They need to dry and be fired first. We'll email you when they're ready to collect, usually a couple of weeks later.

questions.prompt: Object made in class: a small ____.
questions.explanation: 工作人员说每位学员都会手工做一个小碗。
由于主工作室正在换地板，初学班暂时在花园房上课。
工作人员确认周四晚上七点十五分有两个名额。

questions.prompt: What should participants bring to protect their clothes?
questions.explanation: 工作人员让学员带一件旧衬衫套在自己的衣服外面。

questions.prompt: How will the participants know when to collect their pieces?
options: They will check an online calendar.
questions.explanation: 工作人员说作品干燥并烧制好后，工作室会发邮件通知领取。
